                && translation.page_size == rustix_kernel::paging::PAGE_SIZE
                && translation.permissions == permissions
                && translation.pat_index == cache_attributes.pat_index()
        }
        _ => false,
    };
    if returned_frame.address() != frame_address {
        kprintln!("candidate page-table probe failed: unmap returned the wrong frame");
        release_probe_frame(&mut boot_info.frame_allocator, returned_frame);
        release_candidate_after_probe_failure(candidate, &mut boot_info.frame_allocator);
    }
    release_probe_frame(&mut boot_info.frame_allocator, returned_frame);
    if !translation_valid {
        kprintln!(
            "candidate page-table probe failed: candidate walk: {:?}",
            walk
        );
        release_candidate_after_probe_failure(candidate, &mut boot_info.frame_allocator);
    }
    if let Err(failure) = candidate.release(&mut boot_info.frame_allocator) {
        kprintln!(
            "candidate page-table probe failed to release frames: {:?}",
            failure
        );
        halt_forever();
    }
    kprintln!(
        "candidate page-table probe passed: mapped, walked, unmapped, and released root {:#x}; CR3 unchanged",
        root.expect("candidate retains root until release")
    );
}

fn release_candidate_after_probe_failure(
    candidate: rustix_kernel::paging::CandidatePageTables<'_, LimineHhdmCandidateMemory<'_>>,
    allocator: &mut rustix_kernel::frame::FrameAllocator,
) -> ! {
    if let Err(failure) = candidate.release(allocator) {
        kprintln!("candidate page-table cleanup also failed: {:?}", failure);
    }
    halt_forever()
}

#[cfg(feature = "probe-hhdm-frame")]
fn verify_inherited_mapping(
    reader: &impl rustix_kernel::paging::PageTableReader<
        Error = rustix_kernel::memory::HhdmAddressError,
    >,
    root: rustix_kernel::paging::Cr3Root,
    config: rustix_kernel::paging::PageWalkConfig,
    label: &str,
    virtual_start: u64,
    physical_start: u64,
    length: u64,
) {
    use rustix_kernel::paging::{walk_virtual_address, PageWalkOutcome};

    let mut offset = 0;
    let mut pages = 0;
    let mut first_translation: Option<rustix_kernel::paging::PageTranslation> = None;
    let mut permissions_uniform = true;
    let mut pat_index_uniform = true;
    while offset < length {
        let virtual_address = match virtual_start.checked_add(offset) {
            Some(address) => address,
            None => {
                kprintln!("inherited mapping probe failed: {} virtual overflow", label);
                halt_forever();
            }
        };
        let expected_physical = match physical_start.checked_add(offset) {
            Some(address) => address,
            None => {
                kprintln!(
                    "inherited mapping probe failed: {} physical overflow",
                    label
                );
                halt_forever();
            }
        };
        let translation = match walk_virtual_address(reader, root, virtual_address, config) {
            Ok(PageWalkOutcome::Mapped(translation)) => translation,
            Ok(PageWalkOutcome::NotPresent { level }) => {
                if level == rustix_kernel::paging::PageLevel::Pml4 {
                    let pml4_index = ((virtual_address >> 39) & 0x1ff) as u16;
                    let root_entry = reader.read_entry(root.physical_address(), pml4_index);
                    kprintln!(
                        "inherited mapping PML4 detail: VA={:#018x}, index={}, root={:#x}, entry={:?}",
                        virtual_address,
                        pml4_index,
                        root.physical_address(),
                        root_entry
                    );
                }
                kprintln!(
                    "inherited mapping probe failed: {} absent at {:?}",
                    label,
                    level
                );
                halt_forever();
            }
            Err(error) => {
                kprintln!("inherited mapping probe failed: {}: {:?}", label, error);
                halt_forever();
            }
        };
        if translation.physical_address != expected_physical {
            kprintln!(
                "inherited mapping probe failed: {} {:#018x} mapped to {:#018x}, expected {:#018x}",
                label,
                virtual_address,
                translation.physical_address,
                expected_physical
            );
            halt_forever();
        }
        if let Some(first) = first_translation {
            permissions_uniform &= translation.permissions == first.permissions;
            pat_index_uniform &= translation.pat_index == first.pat_index;
        } else {
            first_translation = Some(translation);
        }
        pages += 1;
        offset += rustix_kernel::paging::PAGE_SIZE;
    }
    if let Some(first) = first_translation {
        kprintln!(
            "inherited mapping probe passed: {} ({} pages), first permissions={:?}, PAT index={}, leaf size={}, uniform permissions={}, uniform PAT index={}",
            label,
            pages,
            first.permissions,
            first.pat_index,
            first.page_size,
            permissions_uniform,
            pat_index_uniform
        );
    }
}

#[cfg(feature = "probe-hhdm-frame")]
fn verify_kernel_cache_aliases(
    boot_info: &boot::BootInfo,
    reader: &impl rustix_kernel::paging::PageTableReader<
        Error = rustix_kernel::memory::HhdmAddressError,
    >,
    root: rustix_kernel::paging::Cr3Root,
    config: rustix_kernel::paging::PageWalkConfig,
    pat: rustix_kernel::paging::PatLayout,
    mtrrs: &rustix_kernel::paging::ValidatedMtrrLayout,
    label: &str,
    kernel_virtual_start: u64,
    physical_start: u64,
    length: u64,
) {
    use rustix_kernel::paging::{walk_virtual_address, PageWalkOutcome};

    let mut offset = 0;
    let mut pages = 0;
    while offset < length {
        let physical = match physical_start.checked_add(offset) {
            Some(address) => address,
            None => {
                kprintln!("cache-alias probe failed: {} physical overflow", label);
                halt_forever();
            }
        };
        let kernel_virtual = match kernel_virtual_start.checked_add(offset) {
            Some(address) => address,
            None => {
                kprintln!("cache-alias probe failed: {} virtual overflow", label);
                halt_forever();
            }
        };
        let hhdm_virtual = match boot_info.memory_map.limine_hhdm_address(
            boot_info.hhdm_offset,
            physical,
            rustix_kernel::paging::PAGE_SIZE,
            boot_info.cpu_info.physical_address_bits,
            boot_info.cpu_info.active_linear_address_bits,
        ) {
            Ok(address) => address,
            Err(error) => {
                kprintln!(
                    "cache-alias probe failed: {} HHDM range: {:?}",
                    label,
                    error
                );
                halt_forever();
            }
        };
        let kernel_translation = match walk_virtual_address(reader, root, kernel_virtual, config) {
            Ok(PageWalkOutcome::Mapped(translation)) => translation,
            result => {
                kprintln!(
                    "cache-alias probe failed: {} kernel walk: {:?}",
                    label,
                    result
                );
                halt_forever();
            }
        };
        let hhdm_translation = match walk_virtual_address(reader, root, hhdm_virtual, config) {
            Ok(PageWalkOutcome::Mapped(translation)) => translation,
            result => {
                kprintln!(
                    "cache-alias probe failed: {} HHDM walk: {:?}",
                    label,
                    result
                );
                halt_forever();
            }
        };
        if kernel_translation.physical_address != physical
            || hhdm_translation.physical_address != physical
        {
            kprintln!(
                "cache-alias probe failed: {} physical {:#018x} has inconsistent translations",
                label,
                physical
            );
            halt_forever();
        }
        let kernel_type = match mtrrs.effective_memory_type_for(
            physical,
            pat,
            kernel_translation.pat_index,
            boot_info.cpu_info.normal_caching,
        ) {
            Ok(memory_type) => memory_type,
            Err(error) => {
                kprintln!(
                    "cache-alias probe failed: {} kernel PAT/MTRR: {:?}",
                    label,
                    error
                );
                halt_forever();
            }
        };
        let hhdm_type = match mtrrs.effective_memory_type_for(
            physical,
            pat,
            hhdm_translation.pat_index,
            boot_info.cpu_info.normal_caching,
        ) {
            Ok(memory_type) => memory_type,
            Err(error) => {
                kprintln!(
                    "cache-alias probe failed: {} HHDM PAT/MTRR: {:?}",
                    label,
                    error
                );
                halt_forever();
            }
        };
        if kernel_type != hhdm_type {
            kprintln!(
                "cache-alias conflict: {} PA {:#018x}, kernel {:?} vs HHDM {:?}",
                label,
                physical,
                kernel_type,
                hhdm_type
            );
            halt_forever();
        }
        pages += 1;
        offset += rustix_kernel::paging::PAGE_SIZE;
    }
    kprintln!(
        "cache-alias probe passed: {} ({} pages; effective types match)",
        label,
        pages
    );
}

fn release_probe_frame(
    allocator: &mut rustix_kernel::frame::FrameAllocator,
    frame: rustix_kernel::frame::Frame,
) {
    if let Err(error) = allocator.deallocate(frame) {
        kprintln!(
            "HHDM frame probe failed to return its frame: {:?}",
            error.error
        );
        halt_forever();
    }
}

#[cfg(feature = "inject-page-fault")]
fn run_fault_injection() {
    kprintln!("fault injection: triggering page fault at 0x00000000deadbeef");
    // SAFETY: This is an opt-in QEMU test that deliberately reads an unmapped
    // low virtual address; the installed page-fault handler is expected to halt.
    unsafe {
        core::arch::asm!(
            "mov rax, 0xdeadbeef",
            "mov rax, qword ptr [rax]",
            out("rax") _,
            options(nostack)
        );
    }
    kprintln!("fault injection unexpectedly returned");
    halt_forever();
}

#[cfg(feature = "inject-divide-error")]

    // SAFETY: Integer division by zero deliberately raises kernel-origin #DE.
    unsafe {

            "xor edx, edx",

            "div ecx",
            out("eax") _,
            out("edx") _,
            out("ecx") _,
            options(nostack)
        )
    };
    kprintln!("fault injection unexpectedly returned");
    halt_forever();
}

/// Set once the fatal panic path has started. A panic from inside the fatal
/// path stops silently instead of recursively printing or looping diagnostics.
static FATAL_PANIC_ACTIVE: core::sync::atomic::AtomicBool =
    core::sync::atomic::AtomicBool::new(false);

#[panic_handler]
fn panic(info: &PanicInfo<'_>) -> ! {
    // Mask maskable interrupts before any diagnostics run: another kernel
    // thread must not resume after a panic is declared, and the fatal report
    // must not be preempted mid-print.
    //
    // SAFETY: Kernel panic path runs at CPL 0; masking IF is always sound.
    unsafe { core::arch::asm!("cli", options(nomem, nostack)) };
    if FATAL_PANIC_ACTIVE.swap(true, core::sync::atomic::Ordering::Acquire) {
        loop {
            // SAFETY: Re-entrant panics are deliberately silent.
            unsafe { core::arch::asm!("cli; hlt", options(nomem, nostack)) };
        }
    }
    arch::x86_64::serial::initialize();
    kprintln!("KERNEL PANIC: {}", info);
    halt_forever()
}

fn halt_forever() -> ! {
    loop {
        // SAFETY: The bootstrap has no interrupt handlers or scheduler to resume.
        unsafe { core::arch::asm!("cli; hlt", options(nomem, nostack)) };
    }
}

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Build a pinned Limine hybrid ISO and smoke-test it in QEMU.

Only Python's standard library is required. The Limine binary archive is kept
under target/ and checked against the SHA-256 published for the pinned release.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import select
import shutil
import socket
import stat
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import time
import urllib.request
import zipfile
from pathlib import Path, PurePosixPath

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
TARGET_DIR = ROOT / "target"
LIMINE_VERSION = "12.9.3"
LIMINE_ARCHIVE_NAME = "limine-binary.zip"
# Provenance: SHA-256 of limine-binary.zip v12.9.3 as published for the
# upstream v12.9.3 release (cross-checked against the GitHub release API
# digest at pin time; the release is marked immutable upstream). The archive is
# re-hashed on every run and mismatch is fatal. The upstream PGP signature
# (limine-binary.zip.sig) is NOT verified by this script; verify it out-of-band
# whenever the pin is bumped.
LIMINE_ARCHIVE_SHA256 = "1bdbbcda650c5dba9b1eca5833d598137bf11bd6289bc89b6bcc4f8f112fa676"
LIMINE_ARCHIVE_URL = (
    "https://github.com/Limine-Bootloader/Limine/releases/download/"
    f"v{LIMINE_VERSION}/{LIMINE_ARCHIVE_NAME}"
)
KERNEL = TARGET_DIR / "x86_64-unknown-none" / "release" / "rustix"
ISO_ROOT = TARGET_DIR / "rustix-iso-root"
ISO_PATH = TARGET_DIR / "rustix.iso"

REQUIRED_LIMINE_FILES = (
    "limine-bios.sys",
    "limine-bios-cd.bin",
    "limine-uefi-cd.bin",
    "BOOTX64.EFI",
)


class BuildError(RuntimeError):
    """An actionable error while preparing or testing the boot image."""


def require_tool(name: str) -> str:
    path = shutil.which(name)
    if path is None:
        raise BuildError(f"required tool '{name}' was not found on PATH")
    return path


def sha256(path: Path) -> str:
    digest = hashlib.sha256()
    with path.open("rb") as source:
        for block in iter(lambda: source.read(1024 * 1024), b""):
            digest.update(block)
    return digest.hexdigest()


def safe_extract(archive: zipfile.ZipFile, destination: Path) -> None:
    root = destination.resolve()
    for member in archive.infolist():
        name = PurePosixPath(member.filename)
        mode = member.external_attr >> 16
        if not name.parts or name.is_absolute() or ".." in name.parts or ":" in name.parts[0]:
            raise BuildError(f"unsafe path in Limine archive: {member.filename}")
        if stat.S_ISLNK(mode):
            raise BuildError(f"symlink in Limine archive is not allowed: {member.filename}")
        output = (destination / Path(*name.parts)).resolve()
        if output != root and root not in output.parents:
            raise BuildError(f"archive member escapes extraction directory: {member.filename}")
    archive.extractall(destination)


def ensure_limine() -> tuple[Path, Path]:
    cache = TARGET_DIR / "tools" / f"limine-{LIMINE_VERSION}"
    archive_path = TARGET_DIR / "tools" / LIMINE_ARCHIVE_NAME
    extracted = cache / "archive"
    cache.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    extracted.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    if not archive_path.exists():
        print(f"Downloading Limine {LIMINE_VERSION} binary release...")
        request = urllib.request.Request(
            LIMINE_ARCHIVE_URL,
            headers={"User-Agent": "Rustix-OS-build/0.1"},
        )
        try:
            with urllib.request.urlopen(request, timeout=60) as response, archive_path.open(
                "wb"
            ) as output:
                shutil.copyfileobj(response, output)
        except Exception as error:
            archive_path.unlink(missing_ok=True)
            raise BuildError(f"could not download pinned Limine release: {error}") from error

    actual_hash = sha256(archive_path)
    if actual_hash != LIMINE_ARCHIVE_SHA256:
        archive_path.unlink(missing_ok=True)
        raise BuildError(
            "Limine archive SHA-256 mismatch: "
            f"expected {LIMINE_ARCHIVE_SHA256}, got {actual_hash}"
        )

    try:
        with zipfile.ZipFile(archive_path) as archive:
            safe_extract(archive, extracted)
    except (OSError, zipfile.BadZipFile) as error:
        raise BuildError(f"could not extract the pinned Limine archive: {error}") from error

    def find_asset(name: str) -> Path:
        matches = sorted(extracted.rglob(name))
        if not matches:
            raise BuildError(f"Limine {LIMINE_VERSION} archive is missing {name}")
        return matches[0]

    if sys.platform == "win32":
        limine_tool = find_asset("limine.exe")
    else:
        limine_source = find_asset("limine.c")
        limine_tool = limine_source.with_name("limine")
        if not limine_tool.is_file():
            compiler = require_tool("cc")
            print("Building Limine host utility from the pinned source...")
            subprocess.run(
                [
                    compiler,
                    "-g",
                    "-O2",
                    "-pipe",
                    "-std=c99",
                    "-D_FILE_OFFSET_BITS=64",
                    limine_source.name,
                    "-o",
                    str(limine_tool),
                ],
                cwd=limine_source.parent,
                check=True,
            )
        limine_tool.chmod(
            limine_tool.stat().st_mode | stat.S_IXUSR | stat.S_IXGRP | stat.S_IXOTH
        )
    return limine_tool, extracted


def build_image() -> None:
    if not KERNEL.is_file():
        raise BuildError("kernel ELF not found; run 'just build' first")
    xorriso = require_tool("xorriso")
    limine_tool, limine_root = ensure_limine()

    shutil.rmtree(ISO_ROOT, ignore_errors=True)
    boot_dir = ISO_ROOT / "boot" / "limine"
    efi_dir = ISO_ROOT / "EFI" / "BOOT"
    boot_dir.mkdir(parents=True)
    efi_dir.mkdir(parents=True)
    shutil.copy2(KERNEL, ISO_ROOT / "boot" / "rustix")
    shutil.copy2(ROOT / "limine.conf", ISO_ROOT / "limine.conf")

    for name in REQUIRED_LIMINE_FILES:
        source = next(iter(sorted(limine_root.rglob(name))), None)
        if source is None:
            raise BuildError(f"Limine archive is missing required file {name}")
        if name == "BOOTX64.EFI":
            shutil.copy2(source, efi_dir / name)
        else:
            shutil.copy2(source, boot_dir / name)

    ISO_PATH.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    xorriso_command = [
        xorriso,
        "-as",
        "mkisofs",
        "-R",
        "-r",
        "-J",
        "-b",
        "boot/limine/limine-bios-cd.bin",
        "-no-emul-boot",
        "-boot-load-size",
        "4",
        "-boot-info-table",
        "-hfsplus",
        "-apm-block-size",
        "2048",
        "--efi-boot",
        "boot/limine/limine-uefi-cd.bin",
        "-efi-boot-part",
        "--efi-boot-image",
        "--protective-msdos-label",
        str(ISO_ROOT),
        "-o",
        str(ISO_PATH),
    ]
    subprocess.run(xorriso_command, cwd=ROOT, check=True)
    subprocess.run([str(limine_tool), "bios-install", str(ISO_PATH)], cwd=ROOT, check=True)
    print(f"Created hybrid BIOS/UEFI image: {ISO_PATH.relative_to(ROOT)}")


def find_ovmf_firmware() -> tuple[Path, Path | None]:
    """Find a known installed OVMF image or CODE/VARS pair."""
    directories = (
        Path("/usr/share/ovmf"),
        Path("/usr/share/OVMF"),
        Path("/usr/share/qemu"),
        Path("/usr/share/edk2/ovmf"),
    )
    combined_names = ("OVMF.fd", "ovmf.fd")
    for directory in directories:
        for name in combined_names:
            firmware = directory / name
            if firmware.is_file():
                return firmware.resolve(), None

    for directory in directories:
        for suffix in ("", "_4M"):
            code = directory / f"OVMF_CODE{suffix}.fd"
            variables = directory / f"OVMF_VARS{suffix}.fd"
            if code.is_file() and variables.is_file():
                return code.resolve(), variables.resolve()

    raise BuildError(
        "OVMF firmware was not found in standard system locations; "
        "install the 'ovmf' package (for example, 'sudo apt install ovmf')"
    )


def smoke_test(
    timeout: int,
    *,
    firmware_arguments: tuple[str, ...] = (),
    additional_expected: tuple[str, ...] = (),
    uefi: bool = False,
) -> None:
    qemu = require_tool("qemu-system-x86_64")
    if not ISO_PATH.is_file():
        raise BuildError("boot image not found; run 'just image' first")

    serial_log = TARGET_DIR / "rustix-qemu-serial.log"
    serial_log.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    serial_log.unlink(missing_ok=True)
    serial_path = serial_log.as_posix()
    if "," in serial_path:
        raise BuildError(
            "serial log path must not contain ',': " + serial_path
        )
    serial_device = "file:" + serial_path
    command = [
        qemu,
        "-machine",
        "q35",
        "-m",
        "256M",
        "-cdrom",
        str(ISO_PATH),
        "-boot",
        "d",
        "-display",
        "none",
        "-monitor",
        "none",
        "-serial",
        serial_device,
        "-no-reboot",
        "-no-shutdown",
    ]
    command.extend(firmware_arguments)

    timed_out = False
    try:
        result = subprocess.run(command, cwd=ROOT, timeout=timeout, check=False)
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
        timed_out = True
        result = None

    if not timed_out and result is not None and result.returncode != 0:
        details = serial_log.read_text(encoding="latin-1") if serial_log.exists() else ""
        raise BuildError(
            f"QEMU exited with status {result.returncode} before the smoke-test timeout.\n"
            f"Serial output:\n{details}"
        )

    output = serial_log.read_text(encoding="latin-1") if serial_log.exists() else ""
    expected = (
        "Rustix kernel: x86_64 Rust bootstrap",
        "bundled init ELF validated: entry=",
        "kernel HHDM aliases validated: text/rodata R/NX, data RW/NX, PAT preserved",
        "page-table transition passed:",
        "kernel heap probe passed: bootstrap exhaustion, frame-backed growth, reuse",
        "crabshell: ready (volatile RAM filesystem)",
        "root@rustix:/home/rustix# ",
    ) + additional_expected
    missing = [marker for marker in expected if marker not in output]
    tlb_flush_markers = (
        "page-table transition: global TLB flushed via CR4.PGE toggle",
        "page-table transition: CR4.PGE clear; CR3 reload flushed active translations",
    )
    if not any(marker in output for marker in tlb_flush_markers):
        missing.append("a page-table transition TLB invalidation marker")
    if missing:
        raise BuildError(
            "QEMU did not reach the expected kernel state; missing serial markers: "
            + ", ".join(repr(marker) for marker in missing)
            + f"\nSerial output:\n{output or '<empty>'}"
        )

    label = "UEFI boot" if uefi else "boot"
    print(f"QEMU {label} smoke test passed (bounded to {timeout}s).")
    print(f"Captured serial log: {serial_log.relative_to(ROOT)}")


def uefi_smoke_test(timeout: int, extra_expected: tuple[str, ...] = ()) -> None:
    firmware, variables_template = find_ovmf_firmware()
    expected_madt = (
        "ACPI MADT copied: LAPIC=0xfee00000, 1 local APICs, "
        "1 I/O APICs, 5 overrides"
    )

    if variables_template is None:
        smoke_test(
            timeout,
            firmware_arguments=("-bios", str(firmware)),
            additional_expected=(
                expected_madt,
                "timer IRQ path passed: 3 ticks, EOI acknowledged",
                *extra_expected,
            ),
            uefi=True,
        )
        return

    TARGET_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="ovmf-", dir=TARGET_DIR) as temporary_directory:
        variables_copy = Path(temporary_directory) / "OVMF_VARS.fd"
        shutil.copyfile(variables_template, variables_copy)
        smoke_test(
            timeout,
            firmware_arguments=(
                "-drive",
                f"if=pflash,format=raw,readonly=on,file={firmware}",
                "-drive",
                f"if=pflash,format=raw,file={variables_copy}",
            ),
            additional_expected=(
                expected_madt,
                "timer IRQ path passed: 3 ticks, EOI acknowledged",
                *extra_expected,
            ),
            uefi=True,
        )


def input_smoke_test(timeout: int) -> None:
    qemu = require_tool("qemu-system-x86_64")
    if not ISO_PATH.is_file():
        raise BuildError("boot image not found; build the default image first")
    firmware, variables_template = find_ovmf_firmware()
    serial_log = TARGET_DIR / "rustix-qemu-input.log"
    serial_log.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    serial_log.unlink(missing_ok=True)

    # Keep the QMP Unix socket on the host filesystem; WSL /mnt/c does not
    # support AF_UNIX socket paths.
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="input-smoke-") as temporary_directory:
        temporary = Path(temporary_directory)
        qmp_path = temporary / "qmp.sock"
        with socket.socket() as reservation:
            reservation.bind(("127.0.0.1", 0))
            serial_port = reservation.getsockname()[1]

        firmware_arguments: list[str]
        if variables_template is None:
            firmware_arguments = ["-bios", str(firmware)]
        else:
            variables_copy = temporary / "OVMF_VARS.fd"
            shutil.copyfile(variables_template, variables_copy)
            firmware_arguments = [
                "-drive",
                f"if=pflash,format=raw,readonly=on,file={firmware}",
                "-drive",
                f"if=pflash,format=raw,file={variables_copy}",
            ]

        command = [
            qemu,
            "-machine",
            "q35",
            "-m",
            "256M",
            "-cdrom",
            str(ISO_PATH),
            "-boot",
            "d",
            "-display",
            "none",
            "-monitor",
            "none",
            "-serial",
            f"tcp:127.0.0.1:{serial_port},server=on,wait=off",
            "-qmp",
            f"unix:{qmp_path},server=on,wait=off",
            "-no-reboot",
            "-no-shutdown",
            *firmware_arguments,
        ]
        process = subprocess.Popen(
            command,
            cwd=ROOT,
            stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL,
            stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL,
        )
        serial_connection: socket.socket | None = None
        qmp_connection: socket.socket | None = None
        serial_output = bytearray()
        qmp_buffer = bytearray()

        def connect_until_ready(address: str | tuple[str, int], family: int) -> socket.socket:
            deadline = time.monotonic() + timeout
            while time.monotonic() < deadline:
                if process.poll() is not None:
                    raise BuildError(f"QEMU exited early with status {process.returncode}")
                connection = socket.socket(family, socket.SOCK_STREAM)
                connection.settimeout(0.2)
                try:
                    connection.connect(address)
                    connection.setblocking(False)
                    return connection
                except OSError:
                    connection.close()
                    time.sleep(0.05)
            raise BuildError("timed out connecting to QEMU serial/QMP sockets")

        def read_qmp_message(deadline: float) -> dict[str, object]:
            connection = qmp_connection
            if connection is None:
                raise BuildError("QMP connection is not ready")
            while b"\n" not in qmp_buffer:
                remaining = deadline - time.monotonic()
                if remaining <= 0:
                    raise BuildError("timed out waiting for a QMP response")
                ready, _, _ = select.select([connection], [], [], remaining)
                if not ready:
                    raise BuildError("timed out waiting for a QMP response")
                chunk = connection.recv(4096)
                if not chunk:
                    raise BuildError("QEMU closed its QMP connection")
                qmp_buffer.extend(chunk)
            line, _, rest = qmp_buffer.partition(b"\n")
            qmp_buffer[:] = rest
            return json.loads(line)

        def qmp_execute(name: str, arguments: dict[str, object] | None = None) -> object:
            connection = qmp_connection
            if connection is None:
                raise BuildError("QMP connection is not ready")
            request: dict[str, object] = {"execute": name}
            if arguments is not None:
                request["arguments"] = arguments
            connection.sendall(json.dumps(request).encode("ascii") + b"\n")
            deadline = time.monotonic() + 3
            while time.monotonic() < deadline:
                response = read_qmp_message(deadline)
                if "error" in response:
                    raise BuildError(f"QMP {name} failed: {response['error']}")
                if "return" in response:
                    return response["return"]
            raise BuildError(f"timed out executing QMP command {name}")

        def wait_for_serial(marker: str, deadline: float, start_at: int = 0) -> int:
            connection = serial_connection
            if connection is None:
                raise BuildError("serial connection is not ready")
            encoded_marker = marker.encode("latin-1")
            while encoded_marker not in serial_output[start_at:]:
                remaining = deadline - time.monotonic()
                if remaining <= 0:
                    raise BuildError(f"timed out waiting for serial marker {marker!r}")
                ready, _, _ = select.select([connection], [], [], min(remaining, 0.25))
                if not ready:
                    if process.poll() is not None:
                        raise BuildError(f"QEMU exited early with status {process.returncode}")
                    continue
                chunk = connection.recv(4096)
                if not chunk:
                    raise BuildError("QEMU closed its serial connection")
                serial_output.extend(chunk)
            return serial_output.index(encoded_marker, start_at) + len(encoded_marker)

        try:
            serial_connection = connect_until_ready(("127.0.0.1", serial_port), socket.AF_INET)
            qmp_connection = connect_until_ready(str(qmp_path), socket.AF_UNIX)
            qmp_connection.setblocking(False)
            greeting = read_qmp_message(time.monotonic() + 3)
            if "QMP" not in greeting:
                raise BuildError("QEMU returned an invalid QMP greeting")
            qmp_execute("qmp_capabilities")

            deadline = time.monotonic() + timeout
            offset = wait_for_serial("root@rustix:/home/rustix# ", deadline)
            serial_connection.sendall(b"help\r")
            offset = wait_for_serial("Crabshell commands:", deadline, offset)
            offset = wait_for_serial("root@rustix:/home/rustix# ", deadline, offset)
            serial_connection.sendall(b"pw")
            offset = wait_for_serial("pw", deadline, offset)
            qmp_execute("human-monitor-command", {"command-line": "sendkey a"})
            offset = wait_for_serial(
                "PS/2 raw scancode IRQ: 0x1e\r\nroot@rustix:/home/rustix# pw",
                deadline,
                offset,
            )
            qmp_execute("human-monitor-command", {"command-line": "sendkey up"})
            offset = wait_for_serial(
                "PS/2 raw scancode IRQ: 0xe0\r\nroot@rustix:/home/rustix# pw",
                deadline,
                offset,
            )
            serial_connection.sendall(b"d\r")
            wait_for_serial("/home/rustix\r\nroot@rustix:/home/rustix# ", deadline, offset)

            output = serial_output.decode("latin-1")
            expected = (
                "timer IRQ path passed: 3 ticks, EOI acknowledged",
                "interrupt-driven input: UART RX ready, PS/2 raw scancodes ready",
                "kernel shell thread runtime: cooperative input wait",
                "kernel heap probe passed: bootstrap exhaustion, frame-backed growth, reuse",
                "Crabshell commands:",
                "PS/2 raw scancode IRQ: 0x1e\r\nroot@rustix:/home/rustix# pw",
                "PS/2 raw scancode IRQ: 0xe0\r\nroot@rustix:/home/rustix# pw",
                "/home/rustix\r\nroot@rustix:/home/rustix# ",
            )
            missing = [marker for marker in expected if marker not in output]
            if missing:
                raise BuildError(
                    "QEMU input smoke missed serial markers: "
                    + ", ".join(repr(marker) for marker in missing)
                )
            print("QEMU UART IRQ, PS/2 IRQ, and scheduler-backed input smoke passed.")
        finally:
            serial_log.write_bytes(serial_output)
            if serial_connection is not None:
                serial_connection.close()
            if qmp_connection is not None:
                qmp_connection.close()
            if process.poll() is None:
                process.terminate()
                try:
                    process.wait(timeout=3)
                except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
                    process.kill()
                    process.wait(timeout=3)

    print(f"Captured input serial log: {serial_log.relative_to(ROOT)}")


def fault_smoke_test(kind: str, timeout: int) -> None:
    qemu = require_tool("qemu-system-x86_64")
    if not ISO_PATH.is_file():
        raise BuildError("boot image not found; build the fault-injection image first")

    serial_log = TARGET_DIR / f"rustix-qemu-fault-{kind}.log"
    serial_log.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    serial_log.unlink(missing_ok=True)
    serial_device = "file:" + serial_log.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix()
    command = [
        qemu,
        "-machine",
        "q35",
        "-m",
        "256M",
        "-cdrom",
        str(ISO_PATH),
        "-boot",
        "d",
        "-display",
        "none",
        "-monitor",
        "none",
        "-serial",
        serial_device,
        "-no-reboot",
        "-no-shutdown",
    ]

    timed_out = False
    try:
        result = subprocess.run(command, cwd=ROOT, timeout=timeout, check=False)
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
        timed_out = True
        result = None

    output = serial_log.read_text(encoding="latin-1") if serial_log.exists() else ""
    if kind == "page-fault":
        expected = (
            "fault injection: triggering page fault at 0x00000000deadbeef",
            "FATAL EXCEPTION: vector 14 (page fault)",
            "page fault address (CR2): 0x00000000deadbeef",
        )
    elif kind == "invalid-opcode":
        expected = (
            "fault injection: triggering invalid opcode with ud2",
            "FATAL EXCEPTION: vector 6 (invalid opcode)",
        )
    elif kind == "general-protection":
        expected = (
            "fault injection: triggering general protection with invalid DS selector",
            "FATAL EXCEPTION: vector 13 (general protection fault)",
        )
    elif kind == "divide-error":
        expected = (
            "fault injection: triggering divide error with a zero divisor",
            "FATAL EXCEPTION: vector 0 (divide error)",
        )
    else:
        raise BuildError(f"unsupported fault-injection test: {kind}")

    missing = [marker for marker in expected if marker not in output]
    if missing:
        raise BuildError(
            f"QEMU did not report the expected {kind} exception; missing serial markers: "
            + ", ".join(repr(marker) for marker in missing)
            + f"\nSerial output:\n{output or '<empty>'}"
        )
    if "root@rustix:/home/rustix# " in output:
        raise BuildError(f"kernel reached the shell after {kind} injection\nSerial output:\n{output}")
    if "fault injection unexpectedly returned" in output:
        raise BuildError(f"{kind} instruction returned instead of faulting\nSerial output:\n{output}")
    if not timed_out:
        status = result.returncode if result is not None else "unknown"
        raise BuildError(
            f"QEMU did not remain halted after {kind} (exit status {status})\n"
            f"Serial output:\n{output}"
        )

    print(f"QEMU {kind} fault-injection test passed (halt observed within {timeout}s).")
    print(f"Captured serial log: {serial_log.relative_to(ROOT)}")


def build_kernel(features: tuple[str, ...] = (), no_default_features: bool = False) -> None:
    command = ["cargo", "build", "--release", "--target", "x86_64-unknown-none"]
    if no_default_features:
        command.append("--no-default-features")
    if features:
        command.extend(["--features", ",".join(features)])
    subprocess.run(command, cwd=ROOT, check=True)


def frame_smoke_workflow(timeout: int) -> None:
    failure: BuildError | OSError | subprocess.SubprocessError | None = None
    try:
        build_kernel(("probe-hhdm-frame",), no_default_features=True)
        build_image()
        smoke_test(timeout)
        serial_log = TARGET_DIR / "rustix-qemu-serial.log"
        output = serial_log.read_text(encoding="latin-1") if serial_log.exists() else ""
        markers = (
            "HHDM frame probe passed: wrote, read, cleared, and reclaimed one frame",
            "inherited root HHDM probe passed: read 512 entries",
            "candidate inherited-root clone probe passed:",
            "candidate page-table probe passed: mapped, walked, unmapped, and released",
        )
        missing = [marker for marker in markers if marker not in output]
        if missing:
            raise BuildError(
                "QEMU did not report successful HHDM access probes; missing markers: "
                + ", ".join(repr(marker) for marker in missing)
                + f"\nSerial output:\n{output}"
            )
        print("QEMU HHDM, inherited-mapping, cloned-root, and candidate-map probes passed.")
    except (BuildError, OSError, subprocess.SubprocessError) as error:
        failure = error

    try:
        build_kernel()
        build_image()
    except (BuildError, OSError, subprocess.SubprocessError) as restore_error:
        if failure is not None:
            raise BuildError(
                f"HHDM frame workflow failed ({failure}); restoring the default image "
                f"also failed ({restore_error})"
            ) from restore_error
        raise

    if failure is not None:
        raise BuildError(
            f"HHDM frame workflow failed; the default release image was restored: {failure}"
        ) from failure
    print("Restored the default release kernel and ISO after the HHDM frame probe.")


def process_smoke_workflow(timeout: int) -> None:
    failure: BuildError | OSError | subprocess.SubprocessError | None = None
    try:
        build_kernel(("probe-user-process",))
        build_image()
        smoke_test(timeout)
        serial_log = TARGET_DIR / "rustix-qemu-serial.log"
        output = serial_log.read_text(encoding="latin-1") if serial_log.exists() else ""
        markers = (
            "bundled init ELF validated:",
            "Ring 3 entry stack validated: pid=1,",
            "rustix-init: hello from ring 3",
            "rustix-init: invalid user buffer returned EFAULT",
            "rustix-init: spawn copied user ELF and enforced task capacity",
            "rustix-child: real child entered ring 3 with zeroed two-page stack and is exiting",
            "rustix-init: blocking wait copied child status 7 after EFAULT retry",
            "rustix-init: heap Vec and Box round-trip ok",
            "rustix-init: multi-page mmap zero/write/unmap ok",
            "rustix-spawner: nested spawn/wait reuse passed five rounds",
            "rustix-spawner: leaving one orphan for kernel reap",
            "rustix-init: nested spawn and slot reuse verified",
            "orphaned process reaped by kernel supervisor: pid=",
            "rustix-exec: pre-exec image running",
            "rustix-exec: failed exec left original image usable",
            "rustix-exec: replacement image entered ring 3 with zeroed stack",
            "rustix-init: exec replacement and old-image reclamation verified",
            "init process exited with status 42 and was reaped by kernel wait",
            "Ring 3 init passed: write/EFAULT/blocking child wait/exit syscalls, kernel wait, and process-root teardown",
        )
        missing = [marker for marker in markers if marker not in output]
        if missing:
            raise BuildError(
                "QEMU did not report successful process-root validation; missing serial markers: "
                + ", ".join(repr(marker) for marker in missing)
                + f"\nSerial output:\n{output}"
            )
        child_marker = "rustix-child: real child entered ring 3 with zeroed two-page stack and is exiting"
        # Three init children + five spawner reuse rounds + one orphan.
        if output.count(child_marker) != 9:
            raise BuildError(
                "QEMU did not execute all nine spawned children with two-page stacks"
                + f"\nSerial output:\n{output}"
            )
        reclaimed_marker = "spawned process root reclaimed after wait: pid="
        # Three init children + five spawner rounds + the spawner itself + the
        # exec tester; the orphan is reaped by the kernel supervisor after the
        # runtime drains, not through a user wait.
        if output.count(reclaimed_marker) != 10:
            raise BuildError(
                "QEMU did not reclaim all ten waited child roots as their waits succeeded"
                + f"\nSerial output:\n{output}"
            )
        print("QEMU Ring 3 init spawn-capacity, nested spawn, slot reuse, exec, wait/reap, and root reclamation passed.")
    except (BuildError, OSError, subprocess.SubprocessError) as error:
        failure = error

    try:
        build_kernel()
        build_image()
    except (BuildError, OSError, subprocess.SubprocessError) as restore_error:
        if failure is not None:
            raise BuildError(
                f"process-root workflow failed ({failure}); restoring the default image "
                f"also failed ({restore_error})"
            ) from restore_error
        raise

    if failure is not None:
        raise BuildError(
            f"process-root workflow failed; the default release image was restored: {failure}"
        ) from failure
    print("Restored the default release kernel and ISO after the Ring 3 init test.")

        raise

    if failure is not None:

def user_fault_smoke_workflow(timeout: int) -> None:
    failure: BuildError | OSError | subprocess.SubprocessError | None = None
    probes = (
        ("probe-user-fault", 6, "invalid opcode", False),
        ("probe-user-page-fault", 14, "page fault", False),
        ("probe-user-general-protection", 13, "general protection fault", False),
        ("probe-user-divide-error", 0, "divide error", False),
        ("probe-user-invalid-syscall-return", 13, "invalid syscall return", True),
    )
    try:
        for feature, vector, name, invalid_return in probes:
            build_kernel((feature,))
            build_image()
            smoke_test(timeout)
            serial_log = TARGET_DIR / "rustix-qemu-serial.log"
            output = serial_log.read_text(encoding="latin-1") if serial_log.exists() else ""
            diagnostic_marker = (
                "USER SYSCALL RETURN FRAME: invalid; terminating process"
                if invalid_return
                else f"USER EXCEPTION: vector {vector} ({name})"
            )
            markers = (
                diagnostic_marker,
                f"user fault vector {vector} exited with status {128 + vector} and was reaped by kernel wait",
                "Ring 3 user fault passed: process exited, was waited on, and its root was torn down",
            )
            if vector == 14 and not invalid_return:
                markers += ("user page fault address (CR2): 0x00007fffffffe000",)
            missing = [marker for marker in markers if marker not in output]
            if missing:
                raise BuildError(
                    f"QEMU user vector {vector} did not complete process teardown; missing markers: "
                    + ", ".join(repr(marker) for marker in missing)
                    + f"\nSerial output:\n{output}"
                )
            print(f"QEMU user-mode {name} termination and teardown passed.")
    except (BuildError, OSError, subprocess.SubprocessError) as error:
        failure = error

    try:
        build_kernel()
        build_image()
    except (BuildError, OSError, subprocess.SubprocessError) as restore_error:
        if failure is not None:
            raise BuildError(
                f"user-fault workflow failed ({failure}); restoring the default image "
                f"also failed ({restore_error})"
            ) from restore_error
        raise

    if failure is not None:
        raise BuildError(
            f"user-fault workflow failed; the default release image was restored: {failure}"
        ) from failure
    print("Restored the default release kernel and ISO after the user-fault matrix.")


def active_map_smoke_workflow(timeout: int) -> None:
    failure: BuildError | OSError | subprocess.SubprocessError | None = None
    try:
        build_kernel(("probe-active-mapping",), no_default_features=True)
        build_image()
        smoke_test(timeout)
        serial_log = TARGET_DIR / "rustix-qemu-serial.log"
        output = serial_log.read_text(encoding="latin-1") if serial_log.exists() else ""
        marker = "active mapping probe passed: mapped, accessed, unmapped, reclaimed frame"
        if marker not in output:
            raise BuildError(
                "QEMU did not report successful active mapping; "
                f"missing serial marker {marker!r}\nSerial output:\n{output}"
            )
        print("QEMU active owned-page mapping/unmapping probe passed.")
    except (BuildError, OSError, subprocess.SubprocessError) as error:
        failure = error

    try:
        build_kernel()
        build_image()
    except (BuildError, OSError, subprocess.SubprocessError) as restore_error:
        if failure is not None:
            raise BuildError(
                f"active mapping workflow failed ({failure}); restoring the default image "
                f"also failed ({restore_error})"
            ) from restore_error
        raise

    if failure is not None:
        raise BuildError(
            f"active mapping workflow failed; the default release image was restored: {failure}"
        ) from failure
    print("Restored the default release kernel and ISO after the active mapping probe.")


def thread_smoke_workflow(timeout: int) -> None:
    failure: BuildError | OSError | subprocess.SubprocessError | None = None
    try:
        build_kernel(("probe-kernel-threads",), no_default_features=True)
        build_image()
        uefi_smoke_test(
            timeout,
            (
                            "IRQ-save lock path passed: prior IF state preserved",
                            "cooperative thread path passed: yield, event wakeup, timed sleep, stack guards",
                            "timer preemption path passed: non-yielding workers and FPU state survived",
                        ),
        )
    except (BuildError, OSError, subprocess.SubprocessError) as error:
        failure = error

    try:
        build_kernel()
        build_image()
    except (BuildError, OSError, subprocess.SubprocessError) as restore_error:
        if failure is not None:
            raise BuildError(
                f"thread smoke failed ({failure}); restoring the default image "
                f"also failed ({restore_error})"
            ) from restore_error
        raise

    if failure is not None:
        raise BuildError(
            f"thread smoke failed; the default release image was restored: {failure}"
        ) from failure
    print("Restored the default release kernel and ISO after the thread smoke.")


def fault_smoke_workflow(timeout: int) -> None:
    tests = (
        ("page-fault", "inject-page-fault"),
        ("general-protection", "inject-general-protection"),
        ("invalid-opcode", "inject-invalid-opcode"),
        ("divide-error", "inject-divide-error"),
    )
    failure: BuildError | OSError | subprocess.SubprocessError | None = None
    try:
        for kind, feature in tests:
            build_kernel((feature,), no_default_features=True)
            build_image()
            fault_smoke_test(kind, timeout)
    except (BuildError, OSError, subprocess.SubprocessError) as error:
        failure = error

    try:
        build_kernel()
        build_image()
    except (BuildError, OSError, subprocess.SubprocessError) as restore_error:
        if failure is not None:
            raise BuildError(
                f"fault-injection workflow failed ({failure}); restoring the default image "
                f"also failed ({restore_error})"
            ) from restore_error
        raise

    if failure is not None:
        raise BuildError(
            f"fault-injection workflow failed; the default release image was restored: {failure}"
        ) from failure
    print("Restored the default release kernel and ISO after fault-injection tests.")


def run_interactive() -> None:
    qemu = require_tool("qemu-system-x86_64")
    if not ISO_PATH.is_file():
        raise BuildError("boot image not found; run 'just image' first")
    command = [
        qemu,
        "-machine",
        "q35",
        "-m",
        "256M",
        "-cdrom",
        str(ISO_PATH),
        "-boot",
        "d",
        "-display",
        "none",
        "-monitor",
        "none",
        "-serial",
        "stdio",
        "-no-reboot",
        "-no-shutdown",
    ]
    result = subprocess.run(command, cwd=ROOT, check=False)
    if result.returncode != 0:
        raise BuildError(f"QEMU exited with status {result.returncode}")


def run_debug() -> None:
    qemu = require_tool("qemu-system-x86_64")
    if not ISO_PATH.is_file():
        raise BuildError("boot image not found; run 'just debug-image' first")

    command = [
        qemu,
        "-machine",
        "q35",
        "-m",
        "256M",
        "-cdrom",
        str(ISO_PATH),
        "-boot",
        "d",
        "-display",
        "none",
        "-monitor",
        "none",
        "-serial",
        "stdio",
        "-gdb",
        "tcp:127.0.0.1:1234",
        "-S",
        "-no-reboot",
        "-no-shutdown",
    ]
    print("QEMU is paused; GDB stub listening on 127.0.0.1:1234.", flush=True)
    print("Attach with the Rustix: QEMU (CodeLLDB) debug configuration.", flush=True)
    result = subprocess.run(command, cwd=ROOT, check=False)
    if result.returncode != 0:
        raise BuildError(f"QEMU exited with status {result.returncode}")


def main() -> int:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    subparsers = parser.add_subparsers(dest="command", required=True)
    subparsers.add_parser("image", help="create a pinned Limine BIOS/UEFI hybrid ISO")
    smoke = subparsers.add_parser("smoke", help="boot the ISO and check its serial output")
    smoke.add_argument("--timeout", type=int, default=20, help="QEMU time limit in seconds")
    uefi_smoke = subparsers.add_parser(
        "uefi-smoke", help="boot the ISO with installed OVMF firmware and check ACPI"
    )
    uefi_smoke.add_argument("--timeout", type=int, default=20, help="QEMU time limit in seconds")
    frame_smoke = subparsers.add_parser(
        "frame-smoke", help="probe HHDM access and an inactive candidate root in QEMU"
    )
    frame_smoke.add_argument("--timeout", type=int, default=20, help="QEMU time limit in seconds")
    process_smoke = subparsers.add_parser(
        "process-smoke", help="run bundled init in Ring 3 and verify syscall/wait/teardown"
    )
    process_smoke.add_argument("--timeout", type=int, default=20, help="QEMU time limit in seconds")
    userspace_failure_smoke = subparsers.add_parser(
        "userspace-failure-smoke",
        help="inject a normal-boot userspace launch failure and verify the shell fallback",
    )
    userspace_failure_smoke.add_argument("--timeout", type=int, default=20, help="QEMU time limit in seconds")
    user_fault_smoke = subparsers.add_parser(
        "user-fault-smoke", help="test Ring 3 #PF/#GP/#UD/#DE termination and process teardown"
    )
    user_fault_smoke.add_argument("--timeout", type=int, default=20, help="QEMU time limit in seconds")
    active_map_smoke = subparsers.add_parser(
        "active-map-smoke", help="probe active owned-page mapping in QEMU, then restore the image"
    )
    active_map_smoke.add_argument("--timeout", type=int, default=20, help="QEMU time limit in seconds")
    thread_smoke = subparsers.add_parser(
        "thread-smoke", help="test cooperative and timer-preemptive kernel threads with OVMF, then restore the default image"
    )
    thread_smoke.add_argument("--timeout", type=int, default=20, help="QEMU time limit in seconds")
    input_smoke = subparsers.add_parser(
        "input-smoke", help="test UART and PS/2 IRQ input waking the shell with OVMF"
    )
    input_smoke.add_argument("--timeout", type=int, default=30, help="QEMU time limit in seconds")
    fault_smoke = subparsers.add_parser(
        "fault-smoke", help="test fatal exceptions in QEMU, then restore the default image"
    )
    fault_smoke.add_argument("--timeout", type=int, default=10, help="per-test QEMU time limit")
    subparsers.add_parser("run", help="run the ISO with an interactive serial terminal")
    subparsers.add_parser("debug", help="run the ISO paused with a loopback GDB stub")
    args = parser.parse_args()

    try:
        if args.command == "image":
            build_image()
        elif args.command == "run":
            run_interactive()
        elif args.command == "debug":
            run_debug()
        elif args.command == "frame-smoke":
            if args.timeout <= 0:
                raise BuildError("--timeout must be a positive number of seconds")
            frame_smoke_workflow(args.timeout)
        elif args.command == "process-smoke":
            if args.timeout <= 0:
                raise BuildError("--timeout must be a positive number of seconds")
            process_smoke_workflow(args.timeout)
        elif args.command == "userspace-failure-smoke":
            if args.timeout <= 0:
                raise BuildError("--timeout must be a positive number of seconds")
            userspace_failure_smoke_workflow(args.timeout)
        elif args.command == "user-fault-smoke":
            if args.timeout <= 0:
                raise BuildError("--timeout must be a positive number of seconds")
            user_fault_smoke_workflow(args.timeout)
        elif args.command == "active-map-smoke":
            if args.timeout <= 0:
                raise BuildError("--timeout must be a positive number of seconds")
            active_map_smoke_workflow(args.timeout)
        elif args.command == "thread-smoke":
            if args.timeout <= 0:
                raise BuildError("--timeout must be a positive number of seconds")
            thread_smoke_workflow(args.timeout)
        elif args.command == "input-smoke":
            if args.timeout <= 0:
                raise BuildError("--timeout must be a positive number of seconds")
            input_smoke_test(args.timeout)
        elif args.command == "fault-smoke":
            if args.timeout <= 0:
                raise BuildError("--timeout must be a positive number of seconds")
            fault_smoke_workflow(args.timeout)
        elif args.command == "uefi-smoke":
            if args.timeout <= 0:
                raise BuildError("--timeout must be a positive number of seconds")
            uefi_smoke_test(
                args.timeout,
                ("normal-boot userspace passed: init ran, exited, and was reaped before the shell",),
            )
        else:
            if args.timeout <= 0:
                raise BuildError("--timeout must be a positive number of seconds")
            smoke_test(
                args.timeout,
                additional_expected=(
                    "normal-boot userspace passed: init ran, exited, and was reaped before the shell",
                ),
            )
    except (BuildError, OSError, subprocess.CalledProcessError) as error:
        print(f"Rustix boot workflow failed: {error}", file=sys.stderr)
        return 1
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

struct LimineHhdmPageTableReader<'a> {
    memory_map: &'a rustix_kernel::memory::MemoryMap,
    hhdm_offset: u64,
    physical_address_bits: u8,
    virtual_address_bits: u8,
}

impl rustix_kernel::paging::PageTableReader for LimineHhdmPageTableReader<'_> {
    type Error = rustix_kernel::memory::HhdmAddressError;

    fn read_entry(&self, table_physical: u64, index: u16) -> Result<u64, Self::Error> {
        if index >= 512 {
            return Err(rustix_kernel::memory::HhdmAddressError::InvalidHhdmRange);
        }
        let table_end = table_physical
            .checked_add(rustix_kernel::paging::PAGE_SIZE)
            .ok_or(rustix_kernel::memory::HhdmAddressError::AddressOverflow)?;
        if !self.memory_map.range_is_within_region_kind(
            table_physical,
            table_end,
            rustix_kernel::memory::RegionKind::BootloaderReclaimable,
        ) {
            return Err(rustix_kernel::memory::HhdmAddressError::NotLimineMapped);
        }
        let table_address = self.memory_map.limine_hhdm_address(
            self.hhdm_offset,
            table_physical,
            rustix_kernel::paging::PAGE_SIZE,
            Some(self.physical_address_bits),
            self.virtual_address_bits,
        )?;
        let entry_address = table_address
            .checked_add(u64::from(index) * core::mem::size_of::<u64>() as u64)
            .ok_or(rustix_kernel::memory::HhdmAddressError::AddressOverflow)?;
        // SAFETY: The complete table page was restricted to bootloader-reclaimable
        // memory and its HHDM address arithmetic was checked. The reader relies
        // on the Limine base-revision-3 mapping contract and never returns a ref.
        Ok(unsafe { (entry_address as *const u64).read_volatile() })
    }
}

struct LimineHhdmCandidateMemory<'a> {
    memory_map: &'a rustix_kernel::memory::MemoryMap,
    hhdm_offset: u64,
    physical_address_bits: u8,
    virtual_address_bits: u8,
}

// SAFETY: `prepare_table` accepts only an allocator-issued frame and validates
// its complete usable span and HHDM address. Handles are only used while the
// candidate retains the frame token and this unique backend borrow.
unsafe impl rustix_kernel::paging::CandidatePageTableMemory for LimineHhdmCandidateMemory<'_> {
    type PreparedTable = u64;
    type Error = rustix_kernel::memory::HhdmAddressError;

    fn prepare_table(
        &mut self,
        frame: &rustix_kernel::frame::Frame,
    ) -> Result<Self::PreparedTable, Self::Error> {
        frame.hhdm_address(
            self.memory_map,
            self.hhdm_offset,
            Some(self.physical_address_bits),
            self.virtual_address_bits,
        )
    }

    unsafe fn read_entry(
        &self,
        table: Self::PreparedTable,
        index: u16,
    ) -> Result<u64, Self::Error> {
        if index >= 512 {
            return Err(rustix_kernel::memory::HhdmAddressError::InvalidHhdmRange);
        }
        let entry_address = table
            .checked_add(u64::from(index) * core::mem::size_of::<u64>() as u64)
            .ok_or(rustix_kernel::memory::HhdmAddressError::AddressOverflow)?;
        // SAFETY: The unsafe trait contract requires `table` to be the prepared
        // HHDM address of a complete writable frame; the index is in [0, 512).
        Ok(unsafe { (entry_address as *const u64).read_volatile() })
    }

    unsafe fn clear_table(&mut self, table: Self::PreparedTable) {
        let entries = table as *mut u64;
        // SAFETY: The caller provides a handle prepared by this backend for a
        // complete writable frame retained by its candidate.
        unsafe {
            for index in 0..512 {
                entries.add(index).write_volatile(0);
            }
        }
    }

    unsafe fn write_entry(&mut self, table: Self::PreparedTable, index: u16, value: u64) {
        if index >= 512 {
            return;
        }
        let entry = (table as *mut u64).wrapping_add(usize::from(index));
        // SAFETY: The caller provides a prepared complete frame and an index in
        // range; this writes one entry without creating a Rust reference.
        unsafe { entry.write_volatile(value) };
    }

    unsafe fn invalidate_page(&mut self, virtual_address: u64) {
        // SAFETY: Active mapping callers provide the current virtual page and run
        // at CPL 0 with exclusive local page-table ownership.
        unsafe {
            core::arch::asm!(
                "invlpg [{}]",
                in(reg) virtual_address,
                options(nostack, preserves_flags)
            );
        }
    }
}

#[cfg(any(
    feature = "probe-hhdm-frame",
    all(target_os = "none", feature = "boot-userspace")
))]
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
enum LimineUserFrameMemoryError {
    OutOfBounds,
    Address(rustix_kernel::memory::HhdmAddressError),
}

#[cfg(any(
    feature = "probe-hhdm-frame",
    all(target_os = "none", feature = "boot-userspace")
))]
struct LimineHhdmUserFrameMemory<'a> {
    memory_map: &'a rustix_kernel::memory::MemoryMap,
    hhdm_offset: u64,
    physical_address_bits: Option<u8>,
    virtual_address_bits: u8,
}

#[cfg(any(
    feature = "probe-hhdm-frame",
    all(target_os = "none", feature = "boot-userspace")
))]
impl LimineHhdmUserFrameMemory<'_> {
    fn frame_slice_address(
        &self,
        frame: &rustix_kernel::frame::Frame,
        offset: usize,
        length: usize,
    ) -> Result<*mut u8, LimineUserFrameMemoryError> {
        if offset
            .checked_add(length)
            .is_none_or(|end| end > rustix_kernel::frame::FRAME_SIZE as usize)
        {
            return Err(LimineUserFrameMemoryError::OutOfBounds);
        }
        if length == 0 {
            return Ok(core::ptr::null_mut());
        }

        let base = frame
            .hhdm_address(
                self.memory_map,
                self.hhdm_offset,
                self.physical_address_bits,
                self.virtual_address_bits,
            )
            .map_err(LimineUserFrameMemoryError::Address)?;
        let address =
            base.checked_add(offset as u64)
                .ok_or(LimineUserFrameMemoryError::Address(
                    rustix_kernel::memory::HhdmAddressError::AddressOverflow,
                ))?;
        Ok(address as *mut u8)
    }
}

#[cfg(any(
    feature = "probe-hhdm-frame",
    all(target_os = "none", feature = "boot-userspace")
))]
// SAFETY: The non-copyable Frame token and checked HHDM conversion authorize a
// complete Usable page. Each operation checks its subrange, accesses only that
// page, and uses raw copies rather than forming user virtual references. The
// implementation relies on Limine's mapped-usable-memory contract; hardware
// faults from a broken mapping remain fatal and are not recoverable here.
unsafe impl rustix_kernel::paging::UserFrameMemory for LimineHhdmUserFrameMemory<'_> {
    type Error = LimineUserFrameMemoryError;

    fn copy_from_frame(
        &mut self,
        frame: &rustix_kernel::frame::Frame,
        offset: usize,
        destination: &mut [u8],
    ) -> Result<(), Self::Error> {
        let source = self.frame_slice_address(frame, offset, destination.len())?;
        if !destination.is_empty() {
            // SAFETY: The frame subrange was checked and the HHDM address was
            // validated for the full allocator-owned frame. `copy` permits overlap.
            unsafe { core::ptr::copy(source, destination.as_mut_ptr(), destination.len()) };
        }
        Ok(())
    }

    fn copy_to_frame(
        &mut self,
        frame: &rustix_kernel::frame::Frame,
        offset: usize,
        source: &[u8],
    ) -> Result<(), Self::Error> {
        let destination = self.frame_slice_address(frame, offset, source.len())?;
        if !source.is_empty() {
            // SAFETY: The frame subrange was checked and the HHDM address was
            // validated for the full allocator-owned frame. `copy` permits overlap.
            unsafe { core::ptr::copy(source.as_ptr(), destination, source.len()) };
        }
        Ok(())
    }
}

struct KernelHeapMappingContext {
    candidate: *mut (),
    allocator: *mut rustix_kernel::frame::FrameAllocator,
    cpu_info: *const arch::x86_64::cpu::CpuInfo,
}

unsafe fn map_kernel_heap_pages(
    opaque_context: *mut (),
    first_page: usize,
    page_count: usize,
) -> bool {
    use rustix_kernel::paging::{
        validate_mapping_range, CachePolicy, CandidatePageTables, EffectiveMemoryType, MtrrState,
        PagePermissions, PatLayout, PAGE_SIZE,
    };

    if page_count == 0
        || first_page
            .checked_add(page_count)
            .is_none_or(|end| end > KERNEL_HEAP_GROWTH_MAX_PAGES)
    {
        return false;
    }

    // SAFETY: The caller configures this callback only after the active root,
    // allocator, CPU snapshot, and local context are all live. The boot path is
    // single-vCPU and never returns from the stack containing that context.
    let state = unsafe { &mut *opaque_context.cast::<KernelHeapMappingContext>() };
    // SAFETY: These pointers refer to the retained local candidate and BootInfo
    // members. The callback is synchronous and never stores a derived reference.
    let candidate = unsafe {
        &mut *state
            .candidate
            .cast::<CandidatePageTables<'static, LimineHhdmCandidateMemory<'static>>>()
    };
    // SAFETY: The frame allocator and CPU snapshot remain owned by retained
    // BootInfo; this callback runs on the sole CPU with the heap lock held.
    let allocator = unsafe { &mut *state.allocator };
    // SAFETY: The CPU snapshot is immutable and remains live with BootInfo.
    let cpu_info = unsafe { &*state.cpu_info };

    let flags: u64;
    // SAFETY: The callback runs at CPL 0; save IF before disabling local IRQs
    // while the active page tables and allocator are mutated.
    unsafe { core::arch::asm!("pushfq", "pop {}", "cli", out(reg) flags) };
    let result = (|| {
        let physical_width = cpu_info.physical_address_bits?;
        let pat = PatLayout::from_msr_value(cpu_info.pat_msr_value?).ok()?;
        let mtrrs = match &cpu_info.mtrr {
            MtrrState::Captured(registers) => registers.validated_layout(physical_width).ok()?,
            _ => return None,
        };
        let permissions = PagePermissions {
            writable: true,
            executable: false,
            user_accessible: false,
        };
        for (mapped, page) in (first_page..first_page + page_count).enumerate() {
            let virtual_address = KERNEL_HEAP_GROWTH_VIRTUAL_BASE
                .checked_add((page as u64).checked_mul(PAGE_SIZE)?)?;
            let frame = match allocator.allocate() {
                Some(frame) => frame,
                None => {
                    rollback_kernel_heap_pages(candidate, allocator, first_page, mapped);
                    return None;
                }
            };
            let mapping = match validate_mapping_range(
                virtual_address,
                frame.address(),
                PAGE_SIZE,
                permissions,
                Some(physical_width),
                cpu_info.active_linear_address_bits,
            ) {
                Ok(mapping) => mapping,
                Err(_) => {
                    deallocate_kernel_heap_frame(allocator, frame);
                    rollback_kernel_heap_pages(candidate, allocator, first_page, mapped);
                    return None;
                }
            };
            let attributes = match mapping.select_cache_attributes(
                CachePolicy::WriteBack,
                pat,
                &mtrrs,
                cpu_info.normal_caching,
            ) {
                Ok(attributes) if attributes.effective_type() == EffectiveMemoryType::WriteBack => {
                    attributes
                }
                _ => {
                    deallocate_kernel_heap_frame(allocator, frame);
                    rollback_kernel_heap_pages(candidate, allocator, first_page, mapped);
                    return None;
                }
            };
            // SAFETY: IF is clear, the current candidate owns the active root,
            // and the allocator-issued frame is mapped RW/NX with local TLB
            // invalidation before its token becomes page-table-owned.
            if let Err(failure) =
                unsafe { candidate.map_owned_page_active(allocator, frame, mapping, attributes) }
            {
                deallocate_kernel_heap_frame(allocator, failure.frame);
                rollback_kernel_heap_pages(candidate, allocator, first_page, mapped);
                return None;
            }
        }
        Some(())
    })()
    .is_some();
    if flags & (1 << 9) != 0 {
        // SAFETY: The mapping transaction is complete or fully rolled back.
        unsafe { core::arch::asm!("sti") };
    }
    result
}

fn rollback_kernel_heap_pages(
    candidate: &mut rustix_kernel::paging::CandidatePageTables<
        'static,
        LimineHhdmCandidateMemory<'static>,
    >,
    allocator: &mut rustix_kernel::frame::FrameAllocator,
    first_page: usize,
    mapped_pages: usize,
) {
    use rustix_kernel::paging::PAGE_SIZE;

    for page in (first_page..first_page + mapped_pages).rev() {
        let Some(virtual_address) = (page as u64)
            .checked_mul(PAGE_SIZE)
            .and_then(|offset| KERNEL_HEAP_GROWTH_VIRTUAL_BASE.checked_add(offset))
        else {
            halt_forever();
        };
        // SAFETY: The pages belong to this transaction in the current active
        // root; unmapping invalidates their TLB entries before token return.
        let frame = unsafe { candidate.unmap_owned_page_active(virtual_address) }
            .unwrap_or_else(|_| halt_forever());
        deallocate_kernel_heap_frame(allocator, frame);
    }
}

fn deallocate_kernel_heap_frame(
    allocator: &mut rustix_kernel::frame::FrameAllocator,
    frame: rustix_kernel::frame::Frame,
) {
    if allocator.deallocate(frame).is_err() {
        halt_forever();
    }
}

// Error payloads provide boot diagnostics through the derived `Debug` output.
#[allow(dead_code)]
#[derive(Debug)]
enum AcpiMappingError {
    InvalidAcpiSpan {
        physical_start: u64,
        length: usize,
        error: rustix_kernel::memory::AcpiSpanError,
    },
    InvalidMapping(rustix_kernel::paging::MappingError),
    CandidateMap(
        rustix_kernel::paging::CandidateMapErrorKind<rustix_kernel::memory::HhdmAddressError>,
    ),
    CandidateWalk,
    UnexpectedCurrentCr3,
}

struct CandidateAcpiReader<'candidate, 'memory, 'map> {
    candidate: &'candidate mut rustix_kernel::paging::CandidatePageTables<
        'memory,
        LimineHhdmCandidateMemory<'map>,
    >,
    allocator: &'candidate mut rustix_kernel::frame::FrameAllocator,
    memory_map: &'map rustix_kernel::memory::MemoryMap,
    physical_address_bits: u8,
    virtual_address_bits: u8,
    cache_layout: rustix_kernel::paging::ValidatedMtrrLayout,
    pat: rustix_kernel::paging::PatLayout,
    normal_caching: bool,
    candidate_cr3: u64,
    previous_cr3: u64,
    virtual_address: u64,
}

impl CandidateAcpiReader<'_, '_, '_> {
    fn remove_temporary_mapping(&mut self) {
        if let Err(error) = self.candidate.unmap_acpi_page(self.virtual_address) {
            crate::kprintln!("temporary ACPI mapping could not be removed: {:?}", error);
            halt_forever();
        }
    }
}

// The legacy-reserved authorization is accepted only for RSDP reads; all
// root and child tables require ACPI-reclaimable/NVS memory-map coverage.
impl CandidateAcpiReader<'_, '_, '_> {
    fn read_mapped(
        &mut self,
        physical_start: u64,
        output: &mut [u8],
        allow_legacy_rsdp: bool,
    ) -> Result<(), AcpiMappingError> {
        use rustix_kernel::paging::{
            validate_mapping_range, CachePolicy, PagePermissions, PageWalkOutcome, PAGE_SIZE,
        };

        if arch::x86_64::cpu::read_cr3_raw() != self.previous_cr3 {
            return Err(AcpiMappingError::UnexpectedCurrentCr3);
        }
        if output.is_empty() {
            return Ok(());
        }
        let length =
            u64::try_from(output.len()).map_err(|_| AcpiMappingError::InvalidAcpiSpan {
                physical_start,
                length: output.len(),
                error: rustix_kernel::memory::AcpiSpanError::AddressOverflow,
            })?;
        let span = if allow_legacy_rsdp {
            self.memory_map.validate_rsdp_span(
                physical_start,
                length,
                Some(self.physical_address_bits),
            )
        } else {
            self.memory_map.validate_acpi_span(
                physical_start,
                length,
                Some(self.physical_address_bits),
            )
        }
        .map_err(|error| AcpiMappingError::InvalidAcpiSpan {
            physical_start,
            length: output.len(),
            error,
        })?;
        let permissions = PagePermissions {
            writable: false,
            executable: false,
            user_accessible: false,
        };
        let mut copied = 0usize;
        while copied < output.len() {
            let current_physical = physical_start.checked_add(copied as u64).ok_or(
                AcpiMappingError::InvalidAcpiSpan {
                    physical_start,
                    length: output.len(),
                    error: rustix_kernel::memory::AcpiSpanError::AddressOverflow,
                },
            )?;
            let physical_page = current_physical & !(PAGE_SIZE - 1);
            let page_offset = current_physical - physical_page;
            let page_length = (PAGE_SIZE - page_offset).min((output.len() - copied) as u64);
            let mapping = validate_mapping_range(
                self.virtual_address,
                physical_page,
                PAGE_SIZE,
                permissions,
                Some(self.physical_address_bits),
                self.virtual_address_bits,
            )
            .map_err(AcpiMappingError::InvalidMapping)?;
            let cache_attributes = mapping
                .select_cache_attributes(
                    CachePolicy::Uncacheable,
                    self.pat,
                    &self.cache_layout,
                    self.normal_caching,
                )
                .map_err(AcpiMappingError::InvalidMapping)?;
            self.candidate
                .map_acpi_page(self.allocator, span, mapping, cache_attributes)
                .map_err(|failure| AcpiMappingError::CandidateMap(failure.cause))?;

            let candidate_mapping_is_valid = matches!(
                self.candidate.walk(self.virtual_address),
                Ok(PageWalkOutcome::Mapped(translation))
                    if translation.physical_address == physical_page
                        && translation.permissions == permissions
            );
            if !candidate_mapping_is_valid {
                self.remove_temporary_mapping();
                return Err(AcpiMappingError::CandidateWalk);
            }
            if arch::x86_64::cpu::read_cr3_raw() != self.previous_cr3 {
                halt_forever();
            }

            // SAFETY: The candidate is a complete clone of the current inherited
            // hierarchy with all critical paths verified; this temporary page is
            // supervisor R/NX and the candidate remains owned by this stack.
            unsafe { arch::x86_64::cpu::write_cr3_with_global_flush(self.candidate_cr3) };
            // SAFETY: The CR3 write above installed the candidate root and maskable
            // interrupts remain disabled during this single-core bootstrap read.
            unsafe { self.candidate.mark_active() };
            if arch::x86_64::cpu::read_cr3_raw() != self.candidate_cr3 {
                // SAFETY: Restoring the previous validated root preserves all code,
                // stack, data, and exception mappings needed by this path.
                unsafe { arch::x86_64::cpu::write_cr3_with_global_flush(self.previous_cr3) };
                if arch::x86_64::cpu::read_cr3_raw() != self.previous_cr3 {
                    halt_forever();
                }
                // SAFETY: The verified CR3 is no longer the candidate root.
                unsafe { self.candidate.mark_inactive() };
                self.remove_temporary_mapping();
                return Err(AcpiMappingError::UnexpectedCurrentCr3);
            }

            let source = (self.virtual_address + page_offset) as *const u8;
            for offset in 0..page_length as usize {
                // SAFETY: The exact physical page is temporarily mapped R/NX in
                // the active candidate and this byte lies within its 4 KiB leaf.
                output[copied + offset] = unsafe { source.add(offset).read_volatile() };
            }

            // SAFETY: The prior root remains allocated and its critical mappings
            // were verified before this temporary switch.
            unsafe { arch::x86_64::cpu::write_cr3_with_global_flush(self.previous_cr3) };
            if arch::x86_64::cpu::read_cr3_raw() != self.previous_cr3 {
                halt_forever();
            }
            // SAFETY: The previous root was restored and verified above.
            unsafe { self.candidate.mark_inactive() };
            self.remove_temporary_mapping();
            copied += page_length as usize;
        }
        Ok(())
    }
}

// SAFETY: `read_mapped` authorizes ordinary table reads only through validated
// ACPI map regions; its separate RSDP entry point permits only the bounded legacy
// reserved window recognized by `MemoryMap::validate_rsdp_span`.
unsafe impl rustix_kernel::acpi::AcpiPhysicalReader for CandidateAcpiReader<'_, '_, '_> {
    type Error = AcpiMappingError;

    fn read(&mut self, physical_start: u64, output: &mut [u8]) -> Result<(), Self::Error> {
        self.read_mapped(physical_start, output, false)
    }

    fn read_rsdp(&mut self, physical_start: u64, output: &mut [u8]) -> Result<(), Self::Error> {
        self.read_mapped(physical_start, output, true)
    }
}

// Capture Limine's entry RSP before a Rust prologue changes it. The synthetic
// return slot is part of the SysV entry stack; realign before calling Rust.
core::arch::global_asm!(
    ".section .text",
    ".code64",
    ".global _start",
    ".type _start, @function",
    "_start:",
    "mov rdi, rsp",
    "and rsp, -16",
    "call rustix_start",
    "ud2",
    ".size _start, . - _start",
);

#[no_mangle]
